AUTOMATA / LEARNING LAB

1. Define your NFA

States are inferred from your transitions, start state, and accepting states.

One transition per line. Use ε or eps for an empty move. Symbols are single characters. Multiple lines create branches.

2. Enter a string

How to read the tree
  1. Start at the root with the full string.
  2. Follow every available transition. A symbol move consumes one character; ε consumes none.
  3. The string is accepted if any path consumes all input and reaches an accepting state.

Each node shows (state, unread input). Double circles mark accepting states; only a highlighted node with no unread input is an accepting computation.
